rows.title: Germinal identification page heads its selected commodities quantity column 'Quantity (unit/pieces)'
rows.detail: The germinal products set's copy of the identification page shows a 'Selected commodities' summary like the live animals page, but a germinal consignment is counted per species in units or pieces rather than in animals. The quantity column takes the germinal heading and shows each species' own saved quantity, while the live animals page keeps 'Number of animals'.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page the 'Selected commodities' quantity column is headed 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' and shows each species row's own saved quantity. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-123; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-071; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-057, -p1-110; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-003, -p1-004)
On the live animals identification page the 'Selected commodities' quantity column is headed 'Number of animals'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-110)
rows.notes: This area's part of the existing germinal identification row: the packages column it already holds. req-1776 now heads the column 'Quantity (unit/pieces)' (26 November prototype, ruling:sam-2026-11-27 claim 1), but req-2103, the cross-area restatement in the same existing row, still says 'Number of packages', and that row's criterion says the same. The two adopted requirements disagree on the heading: the combiner must keep one criterion, and the clash goes back to the reconciler if req-2103 is not brought into line. The live animals criterion restates an exists requirement (req-209) only to pin that the germinal heading does not reach the live page; drop it if the combiner prefers the existing row's wording.

rows.title: Germinal identification dates use the 'Choose date' calendar over a text input, with the format, real-date and length checks
rows.detail: On the germinal identification page the collection and production dates are each a text input with the Ministry of Justice 'Choose date' calendar over it, the same picker every other date in the service uses, so the page still works without JavaScript. Each date must be a day, month and four-digit year and a real date, with no range rule and no comparison between the two. The identification number or mark is capped at 58 characters.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal identification page 'Collection date' and 'Production date' are each a text input with the hint 'For example, 27/03/2026' and a 'Choose date' calendar that fills the input with the picked day, month and four-digit year. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-020, -p5-023, -p5-111; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-074, -p2-075; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-057, -p5-058, -p5-073; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-014, -p1-039, -p1-040, -p1-042, -p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-010, -p1-011, -p1-012, -p1-023)

With JavaScript turned off, a collection date and a production date typed into their text inputs save and read back exactly as typed. (ruling:sam-2026-11-10 ruling-sam-2026-11-10-p1-012; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-048)

A collection date in the past, a collection date in the future, a production date in the past, a production date in the future and a production date earlier than the collection date each save with no error. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091, -p1-092)

An identification number or mark over 58 characters shows 'Identification number/mark must be 58 characters or less', in the error summary and inline on the field; one of exactly 58 characters saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-028; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-064; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date not given as day/month/four-digit year shows 'Enter a collection date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field, and a collection date of 1/9/2026 saves. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-079, -p2-080; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-065; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date given as 2026-09-01 shows 'Enter a production date in the format DD/MM/YYYY', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-029; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-078; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A collection date of 99/99/2026 shows 'Collection date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-077; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)

A production date of 31/02/2026 shows 'Production date must be a real date', in the error summary and inline on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p5-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-091)
rows.notes: This area's draft of the existing germinal identification dates row. Combines the calendar date fields (req-252), the identification number length check (req-255), the two format checks (req-256, req-257) and the two real-date checks (req-258, req-259): one page, one validator set, one germinal walk. The cross-area restatements req-2097 to req-2102 in the same existing row state the same rules, so the combiner keeps one criterion per pair. The calendar is the shared Ministry of Justice date picker; its styles belong to the split-off design-snagging theme and this row only uses it.

splitOff.why: It rewords the inset on the live animals identification details page, whose feature folder, identification FIT spec, page object and e2e spec theme identification-and-permanent-address owns. The copy line sits in features/commodities/copy, which commodities-and-reason also touches.

It reorders the cattle identifiers on the identification details page (passport, then ear tag), proved in the identification FIT spec and e2e spec that theme identification-and-permanent-address owns, beside the identifier requirements it already holds. The order list is in services/commodities/rules.js, which commodities-and-reason also touches.

It puts the horse passport first on the identification details page, proved in the identification FIT spec and e2e spec that theme identification-and-permanent-address owns. The order list is in services/commodities/rules.js, which commodities-and-reason also touches.

It puts the passport first for cats, dogs and ferrets on the identification details page, proved in the identification FIT spec and e2e spec that theme identification-and-permanent-address owns. The order list is in services/commodities/rules.js, which commodities-and-reason also touches.
